record.title: Acquire paired FRAM baseline with native identity metadata
record.intent: Obtain a complete stored private-state baseline through the verified read-only wrapper.
requirements: Use a fresh isolated capture and fresh stock owner observation; reconcile descriptor/node/sysfs identities before and after one paired read.
Require exact two-message completion, two complete equal8192-byte images, raw transaction preservation and independent cache/payload comparison; stop on discrepancy.
Verify remote helper exit, complete capture/drop counters and host restoration; seal artifacts without option installation or capability modification.
acceptance: Complete stored baseline or precise negative conclusion is preserved.
